title: compact UBO push의 조건부 조기 CPU State 기록 확대
existingWork: MVKCmdPushDescriptorSetWithTemplate는 compact capture를 하지만 getMetal4RecordPolicy override가 없어 Deferred.
missingEvidence: 작업을 기록 단계로 옮길 뿐 총 CPU 일이 줄지 않을 수 있음.
requiredBoundary: encoder의 독립 layout 소유권·mapped 최신 입력·fallback 순서/시점 검증 필요.

risk.function: 높음: push/draw/query/fallback 순서와 mapped payload 최신 의미.
risk.lifetime: 높음: pooled command가 layout을 release/reuse한 후 encoder가 raw layout을 계속 참조하는 반례. 독립 encoder 소유 계약 필요.
risk.synchronization: 중간~높음: prepared→Deferred 전환/submit adoption 및 실패 경계.
risk.memory: 조기 encoder/native pack과 장기 layout/native owner를 추가로 보유할 수 있음.

strategy: Prepared compact singleton-UBO capture only as State, with independent encoder layout ownership. Command-owned normalized metadata is copied to encoder CPU descriptors; no mapped UBO contents are snapshotted. Native buffer address resolution moves earlier; valid bound resource identity and existing host visibility remain required. Mixed/generic capture stays Deferred.
acceptance: Demonstrate less total or critical-path work, not merely moving work to recording
Review a lifetime/state table for recorded, unsubmitted, adopted, cancelled and reset commands
Independent reviewer closes layout reuse and mutable mapped-input counterexamples
tests: Existing recording group/ownership fixtures for destroy-after-record, cancel/reset, mixed fallback, query/pass order
Functional GPU cases after source/build; no broad early-record enable
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
